name: mighty-nam compact pitch readings
nonce: 1..16383, echoed as little-endian u32 in raw response
reply: prefix, 28 raw bytes encoded with existing mask-first pack7 into 32 bytes, F7; 42 total

raw_fields.7: u8 error: 0 success, 1 capture pending or unavailable, 3 output must be muted
raw_fields.16: u32 frequency in milli-Hz, zero for no reliable pitch

execution: Pitch calculation runs only in foreground, once per completed capture generation. No heap allocation or audio playback. Capture stops automatically at its limit.
controller: One serialized start/read loop; match nonce, CRC, generation and bounds. Cancel on hidden/closed page. Never automatically enable output.
compatibility: NU operations 0/1/2 and NV version 1 retain 2048-sample paged PCM for older phone and Mac clients. Select compact operations only after explicit NAMLNK15 identity.
